Shutter count screenshot/reading from menu or third-party checker
Photo of lens mount and mirror box close-up
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, strap, memory card, box) laid out together

response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Nikon D610 body from the visible logo and partial model text, but working condition, shutter count, and included accessories are unverified or contradicted by visible wear, so it must be priced at worst case (body-only, unverified function, heavy cosmetic wear) until proof is provided.
